seatEase.name: Seat ease (%)
seatEase.help: Amount of ease at the seat level.

waistEase.name: Waist ease (%)
waistEase.help: Amount of ease at the waist level.

curvedDarts.name: Curved darts
curvedDarts.help: Whether or not to used curved darts.

lengthBonus.name: Length bonus (%)
lengthBonus.help: This sets the length of the skirt. Percentage of the Natural Waist to Knee measurement.

hemBonus.name: Hem bonus (%)
hemBonus.help: This option will reduce the circumference of the skirt at the hem. Percentage of the Seat measurement.

hem.name: Size of the hem (%)
hem.help: The size of the hem. Measurement in absolute values.

backVent.name: Back vent
backVent.help: Add a vent in the back of the skirt.

backVentLength.name: Back vent length (%)
backVentLength.help: Length of the Back Vent as a percentage of the skirt length.

labels.backSeam: Add the zipper to the back seam
labels.sideSeam: Add the zipper to the side seam

nrOfDarts.name: Number of darts
nrOfDarts.help: The number of darts used in the pattern. Maximum is 2. This option can be reduced by the pattern if the calculations create darts that are too small.

waistband.name: Waistband
waistband.help: Add a waistband to the pattern.

waistbandOverlap.name: Waistband overlap (%)
waistbandOverlap.help: How much the waistband should overlap at the front.

backDartDepthFactor.name: Back dart depth factor (%)
backDartDepthFactor.help: How far down does the back dart go from the waistband. This is a factor of the Natural Waist To Seat measurement.

frontDartDepthFactor.name: Front dart depth factor (%)
frontDartDepthFactor.help: How far down does the front dart go from the waistband. This is a factor of the Natural Waist To Seat measurement.

dartToSideSeamFactor.name: Dart to side seam factor (%)
dartToSideSeamFactor.help: Percentage of how much of the hip to waist reduction has to be taken in by the darts versus the side seam.
